aero.forms: CD = d0 + d1 S + d2 S^2 + d3 (Re/1e5 - re_pivot); CL = l0 + l1 S + l2 S^2; S = R w / v; Re = density v D / viscosity; dw/dt = -spin_decay_coef v w / R

coupling.form: dyn_loft_effective = clamp(dyn_loft_input + kappa[club] * (face - path), attack + min_spin_loft_deg, domain.dyn_loft_deg[1]); kappa = cot(lie_deg). MODELED: the face change is a rotation of the head about the shaft at the lie angle, with no shaft lean. Every launch step uses the effective loft.

note: Constants the JS port needs to recompute a shot. Frame: x downrange, y right (output), z up. Positive spin axis curves right. Everything modeled unless data.py says sourced.

roll.form: roll_yd = clamp(k * land_speed_mph * cos(land_angle)^cos_power * (spin_ref_rpm / max(land_spin_rpm, spin_floor_rpm))^spin_power, clamped to [0, max_yd] and to cap_frac * carry_yd; land_spin_rpm is the spin state at the landing step; total_yd = carry_yd + roll_yd
